headline: Hi, I'm Kelvin Santos.
intro: I engineer and improve security operations—building reliable detections, automating response workflows, and connecting tools, telemetry, and people to make a SOC more effective.
about: I'm a cybersecurity engineer focused on building and improving SOC capabilities. My work spans SIEM and EDR operations, detection development, incident response, cloud security, and automation. I enjoy turning manual investigations into repeatable workflows and translating security problems into practical engineering solutions.
experience_intro: My background spans security operations, engineering, and systems administration. I work across the detection lifecycle—from designing and tuning rules to investigating incidents, validating telemetry, and automating response.

experience_items.title: SOC & Detection Engineering
experience_items.description: Develop, tune, and validate SIEM detections; improve alert quality, investigate complex events, and turn threat intelligence and telemetry into actionable detection logic.

experience_items.title: Incident Response & DFIR

experience_items.title: Security Automation, SOAR & CI/CD
experience_items.description: Integrate security platforms, automate repetitive workflows and response actions, and apply version control, testing, and delivery pipelines to detection content.

experience_items.title: Cloud, Identity & AI Security
experience_items.description: Work on cloud and identity security controls while exploring secure AI agents, MCP integrations, and agent-assisted SOC workflows.
